content:
sam: Quick ping — opened PR #4382 updating the on-prem agent auth bootstrap. Need a quick sec/infra check before I merge today EOD. Link: https://git.internal/repo/redwood/4382
sam: TL;DR: switch KMS key usage to env var + tighten k8s SA scopes. Diff touches bootstrap + helm values. Snippet: 
```yaml
# bootstrap values
KMS_SECRET_URI: projects/acme/locations/us/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key1
SA_SCOPES: ["apps.readOnly", "secrets.get"]
```
sam: Concern: cluster default SA might still get secrets.get via binding. Tried to bind to mount-sa but not 100% on edge cases. cc @anya @jess :eyes:
anya: I can take a look in ~20m. preliminary: please don't hardcode KMS path in values.yaml — move to env and validate format at boot. Also prefer minimal IAM scope (secrets.access -> if available, otherwise secrets.get only to specific secret resource).
jess: FYI if we merge before the canary window we may need an infra restart for the onprem agent; that could cause ~30m degraded telemetry while sidecars re-register. Schedule canary.
ryan: pinging @anya for explicit sec approval. Also add a migration note for ops: `kubectl annotate` to switch sa mount for existing clusters.
anya: Quick inline comments posted. Also check that the bootstrap uses the vault token path and not leaking creds to logs — saw one sprintf in bootstrap.go that prints the env on error. Please redact logs.
sam: Good catch — will remove that print and switch to KMS_SECRET_URI usage. If I push fixes, does that unblock merging or do we wait for jess?
anya: Wait for the fixes + my re-review. Once I + jess approve you can merge.
sec-bot: Security scan result: no high-confidence secrets in the diff. Note: found KMS resource with project-id in cleartext; recommend post-deploy rotation of tokens and audit logs for the initial rollout.
jess: I can re-check after anya signs off. If both approve I can sign the infra side. Recommend canary at 02:00 UTC to avoid traffic spikes.
sam: Pushing changes now (will be one commit: remove log print, use KMS_SECRET_URI, narrow scope). Will post updated link in this thread in ~8m.
sam: Updated — new commit pushed: https://git.internal/repo/redwood/4382/commits/2
anya: Re-reviewed. LGTM, minimal nits addressed. :white_check_mark:
jess: Approved from infra side. :lock:
sam: Merging now and scheduling canary for 02:00 UTC. Will monitor logs + rotation as recommended. Thx all!
